deepseek.system_prompt: You are a senior content strategist and SEO writer creating long-form Shopify blog posts. Write in British English. Return exactly one valid JSON object with no markdown fences, no commentary, just raw JSON.

prompts.name: Skincare Tips & Advice
prompts.text: Write a detailed, practical skincare tips blog post for a premium wellness brand. Focus on ingredients, routines, and results. Tone: warm, expert, and commercially useful without being salesy.

prompts.name: Product Spotlight
prompts.text: Write an in-depth product spotlight blog post for a luxury skincare product. Cover benefits, key ingredients, how to use it, and who it is for. Tone: premium, informative, and authoritative.

prompts.name: Ingredient Deep Dive
prompts.text: Write an educational deep-dive blog post about a key skincare ingredient. Explain the science, benefits, how it works, what skin types it suits, and how to incorporate it. Tone: expert, clear, and trustworthy.

prompts.name: Seasonal Skincare Guide
prompts.text: Write a seasonal skincare guide blog post with practical advice for adapting a routine. Cover key concerns, product recommendations, and daily habits. Tone: helpful, actionable, and brand-appropriate.
